summary: Check code against its specification: extract requirements, hunt each one in the code, verify divergences

phases.title: Extract
phases.detail: find the documentation; turn it into individually checkable requirements

phases.title: Align
phases.detail: one agent per requirement hunts the code for it; one sweeps the reverse direction

phases.title: Verify
phases.detail: independent agents try to refute each divergence before it is reported

phases.title: Report
phases.detail: alignment matrix, surviving divergences, contradictions between documents
